lua-api.description: Ledger's local, trusted Lua API. Function signatures, argument guards, registration, editor annotations and this reference are generated from ledger-api.xml. Record fields come from ledger.orion. All reads return copies. User automation writes only items, counterparties and rates, inside a transaction during an explicitly writable script run. Configuration, posted documents and derived entries are never generic write targets. Existing posting hooks keep their dedicated entry API. No arbitrary downloaded code sandbox is claimed.

function.name: find
function.description: Read one record by its integer ID. Returns nil if it does not exist.
function.param: Registered database name, normally ib or cfg.
function.returns: A copy of all stored fields.

function.name: fetch
function.description: Read records, optionally filtered by one field's exact value. The filter value is required when field is supplied; integer and string filters are supported.

function.name: field
function.description: Read formatted text of a stored field or a join path. Returns an empty string for a missing record.
function.param: Field or path such as counterparty.name.

function.name: account
function.description: Find an account in the active configuration by its code.

function.name: entry
function.description: Add an entry to the document currently being posted. Only available inside posting, closing and post-event hooks. Fields: debit, credit (code or ID), amount, quantity, content, counterparty, item, employee, asset, currency, currency_amount.

function.name: turnover
function.description: Read cumulative turnovers before the current document plus its entries so far. Only available inside posting context.
function.returns: dr, cr, dr_qty, cr_qty, dr_cur, cr_cur.

function.name: rate
function.description: Read the exchange rate on a date. Zero means no rate was found.

function.name: round2
function.description: Round to two decimal places, halves away from zero.

function.name: log
function.description: Write a diagnostic to stderr with the Ledger script prefix.

function.name: on
function.description: Register an event subscription in the active configuration's Lua state. Currently the platform emits post; callbacks receive a posting context.

function.name: schema
function.description: Inspect a table's fields, types, lengths, relations and whether it is an automation write target.
function.returns: name, writable, fields array (name, type, length, relation).

function.name: insert
function.description: Create a catalog record through the Ledger datasource lifecycle. Requires a writable script and an active ledger.transaction. Unknown fields, explicit IDs, invalid types, overlong strings, invalid dates and missing foreign references are rejected.
function.param: Typed stored field values, excluding id.

function.name: update
function.description: Patch an existing catalog record through its datasource. Same write restrictions and field validation as insert. An ID cannot be changed. Does not repost historical documents.

function.name: transaction
function.description: Run a callback atomically in the infobase editing context. A thrown Lua error reverts every change in the scope and is rethrown. Returning false is an ordinary successful return, not a rollback request. Nested transactions are supported. Requires an explicitly writable script run; unavailable during posting hooks.

function.name: validate
function.description: Validate a catalog insert or patch without writing. Applies the same schema, value, reference and table restrictions as insert/update, and fills datasource defaults. Supplying id validates an update; omitting it validates an insert. Available in read-only runs.
function.param: Existing record ID for an update.
function.returns: Validated record copy; a new record has id=0 until insertion.
